title: Formatting Text & Paragraph Alignment
description: Master character formatting, font styles, Bold, Italic, Underline, and document paragraph alignment.
objectives: Identify ribbon text formatting tools
Apply Bold, Italic, and Underline formatting
Change paragraph alignments (Left, Center, Right)

steps.title: Welcome to Word Formatting
steps.content: Microsoft Word provides a ribbon at the top of the interface. The Home tab contains the Font group, which holds controls for styling text such as Bold (B), Italic (I), and Underline (U).

steps.title: Interactive Challenge: Make Text Bold
steps.content: Use the interactive Word simulator below to format selected text. Click the Bold button on the ribbon tab to make the headline pop!
steps.hint: Look for the bold 'B' button in the Font section on the Home tab ribbon.

steps.title: Interactive Challenge: Align Text Center
steps.content: Titles and headers look best when centered on the page. Click the Center Alignment button in the Paragraph section.
steps.hint: Click the Center alignment icon (middle lines) in the Paragraph section.

quiz.question: Which keyboard shortcut applies Bold formatting to selected text in Microsoft Word?
quiz.explanation: Ctrl + B is the standard universal shortcut for Bold formatting in Microsoft Word.

quiz.question: Where is the Italic (I) tool located on the Word Ribbon?
quiz.explanation: Font formatting options like Bold, Italic, and Underline are grouped under the Home Tab.

title: Tables, Headers & Page Layouts
description: Structure data in formatted grids, insert headers, footers, page numbers, and custom margins.
objectives: Insert and design formatted tables
Add page headers, footers, and page numbering
Configure page margins and orientation (Portrait/Landscape)

steps.title: Designing Grid Tables
steps.content: Tables help present structured financial data, task schedules, and business reports cleanly. Go to Insert -> Table to grid rows and columns.

steps.title: Interactive Challenge: Add Bullet List
steps.content: Use the simulator ribbon to apply a bulleted list to document key takeaways.
steps.hint: Click the Bullet List button in the Paragraph section on the Home tab ribbon.

quiz.question: Which tab on the Word ribbon contains controls to insert Page Numbers and Headers?
quiz.explanation: The Insert tab contains all object insertion tools, including Headers, Footers, and Page Numbers.

title: Styles & Automated Table of Contents
description: Apply Heading styles (Heading 1, Heading 2) to auto-generate structured document tables of contents.
objectives: Apply Heading styles to document sections
Generate an automated Table of Contents
Customize heading font color and hierarchy

steps.title: Heading Hierarchy & Navigation
steps.content: Using Headings builds a semantic structure in Word. Heading 1 is for main chapters, and Heading 2 is for sub-topics.

steps.title: Interactive Challenge: Apply Heading Style
steps.content: Click the Heading 1 style box in the Styles gallery box on the ribbon.
steps.hint: Click Heading 1 in the Styles section on the Home tab ribbon.

quiz.question: What primary benefit does applying Heading Styles provide over manual text resizing?
options: It enables automatic Table of Contents generation and Navigation Pane jump links
It compresses the file size by 50%
It forces automatic printing in color
It translates English text into Khmer automatically
quiz.explanation: Heading styles create structural landmarks, allowing Word to generate automatic Table of Contents.

title: Page Breaks, Section Breaks & Columns
description: Separate long reports with Page Breaks, Section Breaks, and multi-column newspaper layouts.
objectives: Insert Next-Page and Continuous Section Breaks
Split text paragraphs into 2 or 3 newspaper columns
Unlink headers across independent section breaks

steps.title: Mastering Section Breaks
steps.content: Section Breaks allow you to change page orientations (e.g., portrait to landscape) midway through a document.

quiz.question: Which break type is required if you want page 3 of a portrait document to be landscape?
quiz.explanation: Section breaks decouple formatting properties like page orientation and headers between document regions.

title: Graphics, SmartArt & Watermarks
description: Enhance visual documents with SmartArt process diagrams, text wrapping around images, and confidential watermarks.
objectives: Insert SmartArt hierarchy and flowcharts
Configure picture text wrapping (Square, Tight, Behind Text)
Add custom background draft/confidential watermarks

steps.title: SmartArt & Visual Flowcharts
steps.content: SmartArt converts boring bullet points into interactive organizational charts, process flows, and cycle diagrams.

quiz.question: Which Text Wrapping setting allows text to flow tightly around the exact contour of a inserted picture?
quiz.explanation: Tight wrapping wraps text around the precise shape boundary of an image.

title: Mail Merge & Bulk Document Generation Pro
description: Master bulk personalized document generation (Mail Merge) by linking Excel client spreadsheets.
objectives: Execute Mail Merge with Excel client data lists
Insert Merge Fields into letter templates
Generate custom invoices and printable envelopes

steps.title: Mail Merge Business Workflow
steps.content: Mail Merge combines a base letter template with an Excel spreadsheet database to produce personalized certificates, invoices, or letters automatically.

quiz.question: Which ribbon tab contains tools to link an Excel spreadsheet list for generating bulk personalized letters?
quiz.explanation: The Mailings tab contains the Mail Merge Wizard for connecting Excel recipient lists.

title: Track Changes, Reviewing & Macro Automation Pro
description: Collaborate professionally using Track Changes, inline comments, document protection passwords, and Developer macros.
objectives: Track edits and accept/reject suggestions
Restrict editing access with password protection
Record VBA macros to automate repetitive formatting

steps.title: Reviewing with Track Changes
steps.content: Track Changes highlights insertions, deletions, and formatting edits made by editors for approval by the document owner.

quiz.question: Which tab contains tools to turn on Track Changes and insert comments for team editing?
quiz.explanation: The Review tab is dedicated to proofing, spellcheck, comments, and change tracking.
